notes.title: 🛡️ Welcome to Robicon! 🛡️
notes.notes:
We are Hidden Button, a small indie team. Robicon is our first project, and for us, it's more than just a game. Today we are excited to share some important news: the Robicon Steam page is now live, and you can also check out our first trailer there! 🎉

[previewyoutube=sMCTYTWWS98;full][/previewyoutube]

⚡ What is Robicon?
Robicon is a tactical tower defense game with roguelite elements and a love for retro computing. Control your combat platform, place and merge specialized towers, build a defense strong enough to crush endless waves of robotic enemies.

Each mission is procedurally generated, so new challenges await you every time. Upgrade your defenses, adapt to the situation, and discover new tactics — no two battles will ever be the same.

💬 Stay in touch!
If the spirit of Robicon speaks to you, adding the game to your Steam Wishlist would really help us.
We would love to hear your thoughts, feedback, and ideas — feel free to share them with us!

Thank you for supporting indie games, dreams, and those who strive to create something of their own. 🚀

See you on the battlefield,
The Hidden Button Team 🎮🛡️
